content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Hyderabad Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IIT Hyderabad) for project-based senior staff positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies have been announced for Senior Project Staff positions across different specializations including Sanskrit and Ayurveda.

faq.question: Q3. What are the available posts in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The posts include Senior Language Editor, Senior Research Fellow – Sanskrit / Language Processing, and Senior Research Fellow – Ayurveda / Sanskrit.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIT Hyderabad Senior Project Staff Jobs?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 15-10-2026. Candidates must ensure applications are sent before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted through email. Interested candidates need to send their detailed CVs in PDF format to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 40,000/- to Rs. 45,000/- per month depending upon the specific post and qualifications of the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required for the Senior Language Editor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.A. in Sanskrit with a strong background in Kaaraka and Samaasa, along with experience in using Samsaadhanii tools.

faq.question: Q8. What qualifications are needed for Senior Research Fellow in Ayurveda / Sanskrit?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.D. in Ayurveda with good knowledge of Charaka Samhita and Ashtanga Hridayam, or an M.A. in Sanskrit with good knowledge of Vyaakarana.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Hyderabad Project Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based on an interview conducted by the selection committee of the Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates send their application documents?
faq.answer: Candidates should send their details and CV in PDF format to the official email address provided in the notification, which is [email protected].
